items.question: What does Interact actually do?
items.answer: We are a software development studio. You hire us to design, build, and launch digital products—often from zero to production—with one team covering UX, engineering, and launch support.

items.question: Who owns the code and design files?
items.answer: You do. We work in your GitHub org and Figma workspace when possible, and hand off repositories, assets, and documentation at the end of an engagement.

items.question: How do projects usually start?
items.answer: Most begin with a discovery sprint or scoping call: goals, timeline, budget shape, and whether we embed with your team or own a workstream. Then we propose a fixed scope or monthly retainer.

items.question: Can you work with our existing developers?
items.answer: Yes. We often pair with in-house engineers on architecture and design systems, or take a vertical slice (e.g. marketing site + admin) while your team owns the core platform.

items.question: What industries have you shipped in?
items.answer: Compliance (Prevify), marketplaces (Itemz.gg), 3D tooling (Splattr), and editorial/media (Territorio Nacional). We take on new domains when the problem is a product build, not staff augmentation alone.
